data.title: Price increase notice from Beispielstrom GmbH
data.summary: Beispielstrom GmbH informs Lina Mustermeier that from 1 August 2025 new prices apply to her "Beispielstrom Natur" electricity tariff, raising her monthly advance payment (Abschlag) from €64.00 to €71.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is raising prices for your "Beispielstrom Natur" tariff from 1 August 2025: the working price, base price and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) all go up. German law (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) lets you react to a price increase by cancelling the contract without notice, effective on the day the new prices start; an email to the supplier is enough. You don't have to do anything if you accept the new prices - your Abschlag will simply be higher from August. If you would rather switch supplier, the app will show the deadline by which your cancellation must be received.
